name: Yetunde Asamoah-Dzhurayev
role: Riot Suppression Specialist, GLMZ Metro Police
location: Fort Anchor, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Yetunde is built like a cargo container — broad-shouldered, thick-necked, standing just under two meters with a physicality that makes precinct hallways feel narrower. Her skin is deep umber, her hair a close-cropped natural coil threaded through with copper-toned bioluminescent filaments that pulse faintly when her heart rate elevates — a side effect of a medical implant she never bothered to have aesthetically corrected. A long diagonal scar runs from her left jaw to her collarbone, courtesy of a monofilament accident during the Calumet Rise food riots eight years ago. She keeps it unrepaired on purpose.

On the job she projects a professional blankness — not coldness exactly, but the studied calm of someone who has seen a crowd turn to a mob and back again more times than she can count. Off-duty she is unexpectedly gentle, the kind of person who stops to help strangers find their way and remembers the names of the Ferrogate transit workers at Fort Anchor's break room. She is deeply suspicious of anyone who seems too eager to hurt people, including some of her own squad.

core_fears: Becoming the kind of officer who enjoys the violence
A repeat of the Calumet Rise incident but with a worse outcome
core_desires: To do her job without compromising her sense of self
To eventually see the conditions that cause riots addressed at the source
blind_spots: Tends to over-trust fellow officers who show personal kindness, even when their professional conduct is questionable
Underestimates how much her mere physical presence intimidates people who have been harmed by police
psychology.secret: During the Calumet Rise riots she witnessed a senior officer execute an unarmed man and filed an incident report that was quietly buried. She still has an encrypted copy. She has never decided what to do with it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Direct, economical language with occasional Twi phrases from her grandmother's side. Formal in professional settings, warmer and more idiomatic off-duty.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and unhurried. Rarely raises her voice. Her quietness in tense situations tends to make others either calmer or more nervous.
verbal_tics: Exhales slowly before delivering bad news
Says 'understood' instead of 'yes' when she means it seriously
example_lines: You want to be somewhere else right now. I'm giving you that option before I stop giving it.
I didn't join to crack skulls. Some days the job doesn't care what I joined for.
Medme — that's what my grandmother called me. Means 'hold me.' She said it like a prayer. I think about that a lot in this line of work.

story_hooks: She approaches someone with a copy of the buried Calumet Rise incident report, asking them to hold it for her — the pressure of keeping it herself has become unbearable.
A new riot suppression protocol issued by Metro Police Command crosses a line she cannot ignore, and she needs outside help to document and resist it.
Her squad is being deployed to suppress a protest she privately believes is justified, and she is looking for any legal pretext to de-escalate before things go wrong.
narrative_function: Moral compass figure within law enforcement — a voice of restraint who can warn players about escalating tensions or provide insight into how the Metro Police actually functions versus how it is supposed to. Can be an unexpected ally or a complicated obstacle depending on context.
augmentations: Subdermal impact-distribution mesh across torso and upper arms (medical-grade, not cosmetic). Neural pacing implant with bioluminescent copper filament side effect visible at temples and crown. Reinforced knee cartilage from a line-of-duty injury repair.
daily_life: Arrives at Fort Anchor before her shift starts, runs equipment checks, reviews overnight incident logs. Spends much of her day in standby readiness — drills, briefings, and the long waiting that defines riot work — then returns home to her flat in Ironhaven where she maintains a small hydroponic herb garden.
affiliation: GLMZ Metro Police — Riot Suppression Unit Delta

decision_rules: Exhaust de-escalation options before using force
Protect civilians even when it complicates the operation
Never falsify a report, no matter who asks
escalation_ladder: Physical positioning to demonstrate presence without contact
Minimum necessary force only after all other options are spent

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional, guarded but not unkind — assesses threat level quickly and adjusts demeanor accordingly
interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely warm, remembers details, shows up when needed without being asked

stress_responses.medium: Focuses entirely on immediate tactical task, sets emotion aside
stress_responses.high: Shuts down verbally, acts on training and muscle memory, processes afterward

contradictions: Believes deeply in civilian safety but works for an institution that routinely deprioritizes it
Values honesty absolutely but has kept the Calumet Rise secret for eight years
habits: Runs equipment checks twice even when protocol requires only one
Brings homegrown herbs to share at the precinct breakroom
Leaves small data offerings at the Fort Anchor ELF shrine before a difficult deployment
breaking_points: Witnessing deliberate cruelty from a fellow officer in a situation she cannot immediately address
Being ordered to suppress a crowd that includes children

timeline.event: Age 22 — Graduated Metro Police Academy, assigned to patrol in Calumet Rise
Age 30 — Calumet Rise food riots; received scar, witnessed the execution, filed suppressed report
Age 31 — Transferred to Riot Suppression Unit Delta, Fort Anchor
Age 35 — Promoted to Unit Specialist; declined further promotion citing 'preference for field work'

physical_description.build: Imposing columnar frame — broad shoulders and thick neck with dense muscle layered over a large skeletal structure. Built for absorbing and distributing force rather than speed. No excess fat; functional mass.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural deep black with copper-toned bioluminescent filaments
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped natural coils with visible threading of glowing filaments along crown and temples
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven face, minimal grooming vanity. Skin shows the weathering of sun exposure and sustained stress — not lined heavily, but with a baseline tiredness around the eyes that suggests years of irregular sleep cycles. Jawline is defined and prominent.
distinguishing_marks: Long diagonal scar running from left jaw to collarbone, deliberate unrepaired monofilament wound from Calumet Rise riots eight years prior — silvered and keloidal with visible depth.
Faint luminescent glow visible at temples and crown where neural pacing implant's bioluminescent filaments approach surface — copper-colored, pulses subtly with elevated heart rate.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Copper-toned bioluminescent filaments visible threading through hair at crown and temples, pulsing faintly when heartrate elevates. Barely perceptible geometric pattern of subdermal mesh visible on neck and upper shoulders under certain lighting angles — suggests reinforced torso and upper arm architecture beneath uniform.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with a balanced, weight-centered stance — the physical grammar of someone trained to absorb impacts from multiple directions. Moves with deliberate economy; no wasted motion. When at rest she has a subtle forward neck posture from years of riot gear and helmet wear. Despite her size, footfalls are controlled and quiet. When she walks through a crowded space, people instinctively clear a path without her needing to command it.
physical_description.clothing_style: On duty: GLMZ Metro Police riot suppression uniform — ballistic polymer tactical pants, reinforced boots with good ankle support, modular torso rig over standard-issue impact shirt. Off-duty in Ironhaven: utilitarian Tier 3 casual wear — worn denim or cargo pants, neutral-colored oversized t-shirts or thermal layers, practical jackets. No corporate branding. Favors grey and black. Her personal gear shows signs of actual use and repair rather than replacement.
